codes.judul: Perburuan, Penangkapan, dan Kegiatan Jasa Terkait
codes.data_note: KBLI 2025 code 01700 absorbs SIX KBLI-2020 codes (01711, 01712, 01713, 01714, 01715, 01719 — taxon-specific hunting/capture), image-verified on BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 p.134 (six consecutive rows all mapping to 01700). Its served per_skala (2 rows) was inherited from pp28_sources=['01711'] ALONE — a single-ancestor inherit on a 6-way merge. The recorded PP28 absence hunt (pp28/ABSENT.json, 21 lampiran files scanned) covers the declared ancestor 01711 only — the other five ancestors and 01700 itself have no recorded hunt, so no claim is made here about their PP28 presence (cross-family refuter finding, 2026-07-18). An aggregate activity cannot inherit one taxon's licensing row wholesale. per_skala detached; the licensing regime applicable to the merged 2025 scope is not retrievable from the pinned sources as hunted. BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b.
codes.whatYouNeed: This 2025 code merges six previous hunting/capture classifications into one. The licensing rows shown here earlier were carried over from just one of those six old codes and cannot represent the merged activity, so they have been removed from this page; the correct licensing for this code is not yet reliably defined in our verified sources. Before registering or investing, confirm the current requirements with the Bali Zero team.

The served per_skala (1 row) came from pp28_sources=['02409'] — a bare-digit join across editions that ignores both the split (part of the 2020 scope migrated to 02401) and the merge-in of 02404. per_skala detached; which PP28 obligations follow which leg requires per-activity adjudication not derivable from the code number. codes.judul: Benefisiasi atau Peningkatan Kualitas Batu Bara
codes.data_note: KBLI 2020 code 05100 'Pertambangan Batu Bara' SPLITS into 2025 codes {05101 extraction, 05102 beneficiation}, image-verified on BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 p.144. The single served per_skala row came from pp28_sources=['05100'] — PP 28/2025 Lampiran I.D p.202 row 24 (render image-verified at D6; regenerated from the sha256-pinned PDF byte-identically): an end-to-end mining-CONCESSION regime (IUP Tahap Kegiatan Eksplorasi, RKAB, Laporan Akhir Eksplorasi, Studi Kelayakan; Kewenangan Menteri/Kepala Badan) filed under the pre-split code. 05102's uraian explicitly EXCLUDES mining ('tidak mencakup aktivitas pertambangan batu bara … lihat kelompok 05101') and requires beneficiation be conducted 'secara terpisah dari proses pertambangan batu bara'. A standalone beneficiation operator would not plausibly hold a mining-concession IUP; the regime does not transfer. per_skala detached (D5 blind refutation + conductor D6 concur). BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b; PP28 394933 sha 8ad5155a.

codes.data_note: KBLI 2020 code 39000 'Aktivitas Remediasi dan Pengelolaan Limbah dan Sampah Lainnya' SPLITS into 2025 codes {39001 'Aktivitas Penangkapan Karbon' (carbon capture), 39002 'Aktivitas Penyimpanan Karbon' (carbon storage), 39009 remediation residual}, image-verified on BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 p.170. The served per_skala (2 rows) was inherited from 39000-vintage PP28 rows, both image-verified at D6: Lampiran I.D p.1022 row 68 = 'Eksplorasi zona target injeksi Karbon (Wilayah Izin Penyimpanan Karbon)' — a carbon-INJECTION/STORAGE exploration regime (Izin Eksplorasi ZTI, 20 Hari), i.e. 39002-side; and Lampiran I.I p.406 row 88 = 'Perusahaan Penanggulangan Pencemaran di Perairan dan Pelabuhan' (marine pollution response, Dirjen Perhubungan Laut). Neither row covers carbon CAPTURE. per_skala detached; no capture-specific licensing row is retrievable from the pinned sources. BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b; PP28 394933 sha 8ad5155a.

codes.data_note: KBLI 2025 code 02402 'Jasa Penggunaan Kawasan Kehutanan' descends from KBLI-2020 code 02401 'Jasa Penggunaan Kawasan Hutan Di Luar Sektor Kehutanan' (image-verified on BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 p.135; the 2020 code 02402 'Jasa Perlindungan Hutan Dan Konservasi Alam' maps to 2025 code 02101 instead — a cross-edition numeral collision). BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b.
